people.name: Pharaoh
people.line: Egyptian Pharaoh during Moses' birth and early life

translations.web: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.
translations.bsb: “Go ahead,” Pharaoh’s daughter told her. And the girl went and called the boy’s mother.
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.
